title: Top Of The Dunes | KEY.co
description_expanded: With its spacious layout, this vacation home comfortably accommodates up to 14 guests across its five bedrooms and five-and-a-half bathrooms. The sleeping arrangements include a luxurious King bedroom, two Queens, a double bunk bedroom, a bunk bed with a trundle, and a convenient sleeper sofa. The first floor encompasses two bedrooms, a Queen room with a bunk bed and trundle, a sleeper sofa, a cozy living area, and a full-size washer/dryer. On the second floor, you'll find a serene King bedroom, a half bath, a well-appointed kitchen, a dining area, and a welcoming living room. The third floor features a delightful Queen bedroom with a private deck and a charming double bunk bedroom. Each bedroom comes with its own private bathroom and smart TV for added comfort and entertainment.
